comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You may choose one of the following weapons:

Steam-engined Pistol
or
Steam-engined Crossbow

Both are 50 attack power, +2 Gunfire/Bow Attack (Pistol/Crossbow), +1 Sniping, and +1 Arms skill. Do not confuse them with the Improved versions; those are much better stat-wise.

Source: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/topics_cms/campaign/3510.html
